description.zh: 创建的流量包数量。取值范围：1\~20，默认值：1。
description.en: The number of the data transfer plans that you want to create at the same time. Valid values: 1 to 20. Default value: 1.
Specifies whether to enable the auto-payment feature.

description.zh: 流量包容量大小。取值范围：10\~10000。单位：GiB。
description.en: The size of the data transfer plan. Valid values: 10 to 1000. Unit: GiB.

description.zh:
购买时长。取值范围由参数`PeriodUnit`的值决定。

- `PeriodUnit`为`Month`时，取值范围为：1、3、6。

- `PeriodUnit`为`Year`时，取值范围为：1。

默认值：1。
description.en:
The subscription duration. The valid values of this parameter vary based on the value of `PeriodUnit`.

*   If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Month`, the valid values of Period are 1, 3, and 6.
*   If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Year`, the valid value of Period is 1.

Default value: 1.

The unit of the subscription duration.

Valid values:

*   Month (default)
*   Year
The ID of the promotional activity.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the list of regions where Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) Enterprise is available.
